core:resource.gold.name: Gold

core:resource.wood.name: Wood

core:resource.ore.name: Ore

core:resource.crystal.name: Crystal

core:faction.castle.name: Castle

core:faction.tower.name: Tower

core:faction.inferno.name: Inferno
core:faction.inferno.description: A demonic faction aligned with evil, relying on fire magic and devils.

core:faction.necropolis.description: An undead faction aligned with evil, raising fallen enemies as skeletons.

core:faction.dungeon.name: Dungeon
core:faction.dungeon.description: A subterranean faction aligned with evil, featuring warlocks, minotaurs, and black dragons.

core:faction.stronghold.name: Stronghold
core:faction.stronghold.description: A barbaric faction aligned with neutrality, focusing on raw physical power and large beasts.

core:faction.fortress.name: Fortress
core:faction.fortress.description: A swamp faction aligned with neutrality, featuring beastmasters, lizardmen, and hydras.

core:skill.airMagic.description: Increases the effectiveness and reduces the cost of Air spells.

core:skill.archery.description: Increases the damage done by ranged attacking creatures.

core:skill.scouting.name: Scouting

core:skill.waterMagic.name: Water Magic

core:spell.airShield.name: Air Shield

core:spell.berserk.description: Causes the target unit to attack the nearest creature, friend or foe.

core:spell.bless.name: Bless

core:spell.lightningBolt.description: Causes massive electrical damage to a single enemy unit.
